notes.title: Awesome update 2
notes.notes:
Dear Cat Lovers!

Patch 0.9.4 is out, bringing you:

 Australia – unlockable after America – two brand-new maps full of kangaroos, spiders, and bats!

A new cat – a tricolor feline with a truly powerful special ability!

 [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/33faef56b0cdd6c20dcecb4313df3942d8c39a87.gif"]

Additionally, we’ve slightly adjusted our plans: the full version of the game will now launch with the next update.

We’re counting on your feedback.

Have fun and enjoy!

notes.title: Awesome update 1
notes.notes:
Attention all feline units!
Patch 0.9.3 has just landed—like a cat on its feet—and it brings:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/7420c63cd3acf8493214ad03dcc32e6d26d9c509.gif


The Underwater Map – unlocks right after Asia! Dive into the depths, battle crabs, sharks, and jellyfish (yes, they’re grumpy), and claim a reward that’ll knock the whiskers off your face!
Rage Potion – your cat gets so mad it can take down enemies with a single glare. Side effects may include fury, eye sparks, and total chaos.
Wealth Potion – with this baby, prices won’t scare you anymore. A rich cat is a happy cat.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45160354/454f0c4748112973202d0ddee72996402a90687b.gif

Happy meowing and good luck out there!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
"Laser Battle Cats" is coming—with a meow loud enough to shake continents.

Collect cats, feed them suspicious milk, and gear them up with laser-powered contraptions. Set out on missions full of shooting, battery charging, and physics-based puzzles. Take down pigeons in Europe and snakes in Africa. Each cat has unique stats—find your favorites and train them for battle.

Between missions, upgrade your base: grow herbs, improve your workshop, and brew powerful mixtures for your fluffy warriors.

April 18, 2025 – wishlist now and prepare for feline domination
